(d) any extraordinary, non-recurring or unusual gains.

definitions.excerpt: "Consolidated EBITDA" means, with respect to any Person for any period, the Consolidated Net Income of such Person and its Subsidiaries for such period: (1) increased (without duplication) by ... (2) decreased (without duplication) by ...
sufficiencyReasons: Several addback/deduction clauses ((d) non-cash-charge election and future clawback, (i) funding-source tracing condition, and the discontinued-operations timing conditions in (p) and (2)(c), plus the nested reversal carve-back in (2)(a)) are election- or event-dependent procedural mechanics that cannot be reduced to a static arithmetic value; they are represented via nested UNSUPPORTED nodes that still carry/consume the relevant inventory items.

Clause (l)'s run-rate savings addback and the pro forma adjustments permitted under Section 1.07(3) draw on ONE shared 15%-of-Acquired-EBITDA ceiling; because Section 1.07(3) itself is a separate, only partially retrieved provision outside this submission and its own usage against the ceiling is not quantified here, the MIN() cap applied to clause (l) treats the full ceiling as available to clause (l) alone, which may overstate clause (l)'s standalone headroom if Section 1.07(3) amounts are concurrently drawn - flagged as a simplification, not adjudicated.
Clause (g) is reserved and carries no substantive/computational content.

Core additive/subtractive structure, the two aggregate caps (10% on (f)/(m)/(n); 15% on (l)+Section 1.07(3)), and the Section 1.07 pro forma cross-reference are otherwise faithfully and completely represented.
